tasks.label: check sectors count
args: from pathlib import Path; from dotenv import load_dotenv; import os,mysql.connector; load_dotenv(Path('/Users/linhao/code/AI/stock_pb_calc/web_rebuild/.env'), override=True); conn=mysql.connector.connect(host=os.getenv('MYSQL_HOST'), port=int(os.getenv('MYSQL_PORT','3306')), user=os.getenv('MYSQL_USER'), password=os.getenv('MYSQL_PASSWORD'), database=os.getenv('MYSQL_DATABASE'), charset='utf8mb4'); cur=conn.cursor(); cur.execute("SHOW TABLES LIKE 'sectors'"); print(f'table_exists={cur.fetchone() is not None}'); cur.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sectors'); print(f'count={cur.fetchone()[0]}'); cur.execute('SELECT sector_id, sector_name FROM sectors ORDER BY sector_id LIMIT 5'); [print(row) for row in cur.fetchall()]; cur.close(); conn.close()
